SessionStart.description: Inject METHODOLOGY.md doctrine (decision-sizing triad + reasoning scaffold) into session context. Tier: minimal (always on) -- disabling this is a functionality loss, not a noise reduction.

Bridge hook-only ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} into the session as ${MH_PLUGIN_ROOT} so command markdown (no official ${CLAUDE_COMMAND_DIR}) can reference bundled scripts portably. Tier: minimal (always on) -- other scripts depend on the env var this sets.

Advisory: surface memory-lint findings (dangling links, orphans, index drift) at session start, plus an UNINDEXED fold-vs-forgotten triage when applicable — silent when clean; restores the surfacing loop dropped in the 2026-06-27 reset. Tier: standard.

UserPromptSubmit.description: Advisory: when user prompt looks like non-trivial engineering work, nudge mattpocock-skills:grilling, then the user types /mattpocock-skills:to-spec → /mattpocock-skills:to-tickets → /mattpocock-skills:implement. Tier: standard.
Advisory: when user prompt mentions Jira/Confluence/TP-* work, nudge routing through jira-acli's skills before any raw acli command or direct Atlassian MCP tool call. Never blocks. Tier: standard.

PreToolUse.description: T12 (#91): single PreToolUse entry point, replacing the 9 individual gate registrations below (irrecoverable, verifier-protect x2, db-write, task-complete-separation, atlassian-mcp-gate x2, worktree-guard x2). Fans out in parallel to every gate whose matcher matches this tool call per hooks/pretooluse-table.json, merges results per Claude Code's own documented precedence (deny > defer > ask > allow; a blocking decision suppresses updatedInput; additionalContext concatenated) -- see hooks/dispatch-pretooluse.py's own header for the verified doc citations. All 9 table entries are gate:* -- immune to any profile/kill-switch (no PreToolUse hook here is advisory-tiered). Each underlying gate script is unchanged.

PostToolUse.description: PostToolUse(Skill): journal every skill invocation (skill, plugin, ts) to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/skill-usage.jsonl -- usage evidence for the future matt-skill vs harness-skill overlap cull (#90/T11). Invocation counts only, no outcome/success field -- no reliable success signal exists for a Skill call (see hooks/session/skill-usage-telemetry.sh's header). This event has no decision control -- audit logging only. Tier: minimal (always on) -- silent bookkeeping, not advisory noise.

Stop.description: Stop: track cumulative token and cost metrics per session; appends to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/costs.jsonl. Tier: minimal (always on) -- silent bookkeeping, not advisory noise.

Stop: if the current project's memory store is already a git repo (opt-in, one-time user-run `git init` — this hook never inits it), commit any dirty changes for a real audit trail / rollback path. No-op otherwise. Tier: minimal (always on) -- silent bookkeeping, not advisory noise.

Stop: if a task this session created via TaskCreate still shows status in_progress with no TaskUpdate call for it since, nudge the model via additionalContext before the turn ends. Synchronous (not async) — additionalContext from an async hook only lands next turn, too late to matter. Deduped to one nudge per task per session via a marker file; never fires on stop_hook_active to avoid re-triggering itself. Tier: strict.

PreCompact.description: PreCompact: flush a deterministic snapshot (git HEAD, git status --porcelain, plugin/marketplace manifest versions) to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/precompact-snapshots.jsonl before compaction runs (#92/T13) -- a computational backstop for the same class of fact CLAUDE.md's own Compact-instructions section already asks the compacting model to preserve in prose. Pure flush, never a gate -- PreCompact supports permissionDecision:deny to block compaction, but this hook never emits one. Tier: minimal (always on) -- silent bookkeeping, not advisory noise.

SessionEnd.description: Advisory: remind the operator that mh:learn exists when the session had enough activity (transcript user-turn count) to plausibly contain a durable learning. Never blocks — SessionEnd has no decision control. Emits to stderr (SessionEnd stdout is discarded; stderr is shown to the user). Tier: strict.

InstructionsLoaded.description: Journal every CLAUDE.md / .claude/rules/*.md load (file_path, memory_type, load_reason, session_id) to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/instructions-loaded.jsonl. This event has no decision control — output is discarded — so this is audit logging only, never surfaced in-session. Tier: minimal (always on) -- pure audit logging, not advisory noise.
